verdict.rationale: The product's own catalog page at aihero.dev/skills lists 25–27 skills, each with a one-line description. It invites users to pick and install only the ones they want, and the bundle is also listed in Claude Code's official marketplace and in Codex/Copilot plugin marketplaces. That lets a developer browse what is available before installing anything. missing for 10: search or filtering over the catalog, a broader registry or leaderboard beyond this single author's set, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the browsing experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or search a catalog of available skills — a registry, leaderboard, or marketplace listing — before installing anything
